code:
apiVersion: audit.k8s.io/v1
kind: Policy
rules:
  - level: RequestResponse
    resources:
      - group: ""
        resources: ["secrets"]
  - level: Metadata
    resources:
      - group: ""
        resources: ["pods"]
  - level: None
    users: ["system:kube-proxy"]
caption: Wired in with --audit-policy-file and --audit-log-path on kube-apiserver.

eyebrow: Encrypting Secrets before etcd ever sees them
code:
apiVersion: apiserver.config.k8s.io/v1
kind: EncryptionConfiguration
resources:
  - resources: ["secrets"]
    providers:
      - aescbc:
          keys:
            - name: key1
              secret: <base64-encoded-32-byte-key>
      - identity: {}
caption: Without this, Secrets sit in etcd base64-encoded — not encrypted — readable by anyone with raw access.
Restrict ports 2379/2380 to control-plane nodes only, and encrypt before you back up — an unencrypted snapshot is just as readable as the live store.
